extraction.name: MINT-1T
extraction.description: MINT-1T is a one trillion token multimodal interleaved pre-training dataset comprising 3.4 billion images and text sourced from HTML, PDFs, and ArXiv documents.
extraction.creator: Anas Awadalla, Le Xue, Oscar Lo, Manli Shu, Hannah Lee, Etash Guha, Matt Jordan, Sheng Shen, Mohamed Awadalla, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, Ran Xu, Yejin Choi, Ludwig Schmidt
extraction.publisher: University of Washington, Salesforce Research, Stanford University, University of Texas at Austin, University of California, Berkeley
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The data is parsed from HTML and PDF documents that come from CommonCrawl and ArXiv dumps. The data is filtered using a series of rules-based heuristics and deduplication methods.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: CommonCrawl WARC dumps from 2017 to 2024, CommonCrawl WAT dumps from 2023 to 2024, and ArXiv S3 buckets.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: The data was collected from January 2024 to June 2024. The dataset includes web data from 2013 to 2024.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The dataset was preprocessed to remove low quality text, duplicate documents/text portions, and remove not safe for work (NSFW) and low quality images. Non-English documents were eliminated using Fasttext. Documents with URLs containing NSFW substrings were removed. Images smaller than 150 pixels or larger than 20,000 pixels, and images with extreme aspect ratios were removed. Email addresses and IP addresses were anonymized. Paragraph and document text deduplication, as well as image deduplication, were performed.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset will be maintained and updated by the authors. Updates will be communicated through the README in the Huggingface interface. Older versions of the dataset can be found using the Git history. A Google form will be provided for opting data out of MINT-1T.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset is sourced from the public web, so it is possible to find images of individuals as well as text about specific individuals. Personally identifiable information such as emails and IP addresses were masked to remove personal data.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The authors took measures to filter out personally identifiable information and NSFW content to avoid exposing harmful content from the web. The authors state that using the dataset to train models that ingest or generate personally identifying information, as well as military applications, are inappropriate use cases.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The authors avoided using model-based heuristics for text filtering (text quality classifier models) as they have been shown to favor text from certain demographics.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Limitations include potential link rot since the dataset relies on downloading external image URLs. Additionally, there are PDF parsing issues where images might not be detected or incorrect reading orders are extracted due to arbitrary document layouts.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Pre-training large multimodal models (LMMs), generating interleaved images and text sequences, and building multimodal document retrieval systems.
